params.name: sort
params.description:
Sort resources by field and direction. May be used multiple times.

For more information, see "[Sorting](#description/sorting)".

params.name: type
params.description:
Filter resources by type. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain the resources with the specified type.

params.name: status
params.description:
Filter resources by status. May be used multiple times.

The response will only contain the resources with the specified status.

params.name: bound_to
params.description:
Filter Images by their linked Server ID. May be used multiple times.

Only available for Images of type `backup`.

params.name: name
params.description:
Filter resources by their name.

The response will only contain the resources
matching exactly the specified name.

params.name: label_selector
params.description:
Filter resources by labels.

The response will only contain resources matching the label selector.
For more information, see "[Label Selector](#description/label-selector)".

params.name: architecture
params.description:
Filter resources by cpu architecture.

The response will only contain the resources with the specified cpu architecture.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to return. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

params.name: per_page
params.description: Maximum number of entries returned per page. For more information, see "[Pagination](#description/pagination)".

items.docs: Returns all Image objects. You can select specific Image types only and sort the results by using URI parameters.
Updates the Image. You may change the description, convert a Backup Image to a Snapshot Image or change the Image labels. Only Images of type `snapshot` and `backup` can be updated.
Deletes an Image. Only Images of type `snapshot` and `backup` can be deleted.
